items.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015
items.q: we were just married and I think I had Ann already though

ctx.x: Stuff like who’s at home, who balances the checkbook, who balances the checkbook in your family?

I did, up until recently. No but I did because we were just married and I think I had Ann already though, we lived in Clifton. And I always remember doing, he gave me, “here, you do it, the bank. Checking, cash and what was the other one, there was three of them, and we’d know exactly — savings, cash and checking. But anyway he’d give me the checks and whatever and I would sit at the kitchen table and do cash and this — and not even thinking of like gee we’d better put twenty dollars away or fifty dollars or a…
I won’t tell the IRS but did you always put down the cash gigs?
